extension.summary: A question on the idle screen, answered a few seconds later
extension.description: Turns an idle TV into a slow quiz: one OpenTriviaQA question with four answers, a countdown bar, then the right answer marked in green while the others fade. It then moves on to another question. Choose the seconds before the reveal and how long the answer stays up, which of the 22 categories to draw from, and whether the countdown bar is shown. Ink, Paper and Midnight themes (or Auto by time of day), five accents or your own colours, cards or list layout, text size, and optional dimming for OLED screens. Any key or click exits straight away. Questions are read from a database in shuffled blocks, so it never runs out.
